implementation: Original, locally constructed Canvas vector paths. No external SVG files or other reference assets are copied or requested at runtime.

posters.title: Endless Layers

posters.title: Petal Orbit

posters.title: Arch Current
posters.shape: Nested half-donut arches with long vertical legs
posters.motion: Phase-delayed arch drifts around an orbiting accent.

posters.title: Quiet Weave
posters.motion: Gentle diagonal sway and translation with true alternating crossings.

posters.title: Prism Tide
posters.motion: Staggered floating, soft scale changes and slight tilts.

posters.title: Nested Passage
